parameter_summary: After the approved implementation PR actually merges, push one ledger-only closeout branch and create its PR against main to publish TASK-0046's real merge record and delivery notes.
conditions: This is the mechanical audit closeout of the same explicitly authorized delivery, not a new implementation or a fresh code approval.
The implementation PR has merged into main after required CI success, and its tested head and TASK-0046 subject are ancestors of its actual merge commit.
The CLI has recorded that actual implementation merge using close; retain all historical events and evidence.
Relative to updated main, the closeout changes only TASK-0046 task state, appended events, delivery notes and the closeout PR description.
The worktree is clean, the remote closeout branch contains no unrelated work, and there is no force push, deletion, deployment, release, tag or protection change.
